turn.content: The PO price is 356500; the invoice bills 403300. The only price change in the contract (Addendum No. 1) applies to a different item (External SSD 1TB), not the Antivirus License, and clause #2.2 forbids retroactive/unaddended changes. No contract clause raises the Antivirus price.

tool_calls.name: submit_report
tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0052", "detail": "Line for 'Antivirus License 1 Year' has unit price 356500."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "OSC26100500", "detail": "Line 1 bills unit price 403300, above the PO price of 356500."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-012#2.2", "detail": "A price change takes effect only via a signed written addendum and never retroactively; no addendum raises the Antivirus License price."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-012#11.1", "detail": "The only price change (Addendum No. 1) applies to External SSD 1TB, not the Antivirus License."}], "explanation": "The invoice's unit price of 403300 exceeds the PO price of 356500 for the same item, and no contract clause authorizes a higher price for the Antivirus License, so this is an overcharge."}]}
